name: cto
title: CTO Sub-Orchestration
description: Top-level CTO run: discovery -> decomposition -> parallel teams -> integration review -> summary. Never auto-selected by classification (match.type = [] — the CTO profile is invoked explicitly via /cto). The 'teams' stage is filled at runtime from .omp/teams.json by the CTO agent.

completion_intent.rationale: CTO orchestration hands off a bounded TeamPlan and integration result; user-owned wave decisions remain explicit.

confirm_understanding.rationale: The CTO confirms task understanding before decomposition.

confirm_plan.rationale: The TeamPlan is an explicit user-owned orchestration decision.

confirm_contract.rationale: The cross-team contract requires explicit acceptance.

user_accepts.rationale: Integration acceptance cannot be inferred from artifact completion.

checkpoint_policy.rationale: Conservative typed opt-in policy keeps load-bearing CTO wave decisions human-required.

stages.title: Decomposition
stages.autonomous: proceed with the proposed TeamPlan (documented defaults)

stages.title: Cross-Team Architecture
stages.autonomous: proceed with the architect's contract (documented defaults)
